The Top 10 Most Followed K-Pop Idols On Instagram In 2026 - Koreaboo

K-Pop idols are some of the most influential celebrities on social media, and Instagram is one of the main ways they connect with fans around the world. First up is Cha Eunwoo with 47.3M followers. He often posts photos and reels about his music and acting work, fashion shoots, travel, and lifestyle content.

results.text:
Top 30 Most Followed Kpop Idols On Instagram (2026)

Welcome to 2026! In the world of K-Pop, influence isn’t just measured by music show wins or album sales anymore, it’s measured in millions of followers. Instagram has become the ultimate battlefield for global popularity, giving fans a direct line to their favorite stars.

Whether you are a seasoned stan or a new fan just learning the ropes, you might be wondering: Who actually rules the platform right now?

Here is the definitive list of the most followed K-Pop idols on Instagram in 2026, along with a quick guide on who they are and why they are so famous.

Here is a blog post detailing the most followed K-Pop idols on Instagram for 2026.

## 1. Lisa (Lalisa Manobal)

- Approximate Followers: ~106 Million
- Group: BLACKPINK
- Instagram Handle:@lalalalisa_m

Lisa is the undisputed queen of K-Pop Instagram. Born in Thailand, she is the main dancer and lead rapper of the global sensation BLACKPINK. Lisa is known for her unmatched stage presence, sharp dance moves, and distinct rap style. Beyond music, she is a massive fashion icon, serving as a global ambassador for luxury brands like Celine and Bulgari. Her solo hits like “LALISA” and “MONEY” broke records worldwide, cementing her status as a global superstar independent of her group.

## 2. Jennie (Jennie Kim)

- Approximate Followers: ~88 Million
- Group: BLACKPINK
- Instagram Handle:@jennierubyjane

Jennie acts as the main rapper and lead vocalist of BLACKPINK. She is often called the “Human Chanel” due to her long-standing partnership with the French luxury house. Jennie was the first member of her group to debut solo with the appropriately named track “SOLO.” She is also an actress, having made her Hollywood debut in HBO’s The Idol. On Instagram, she is famous for setting “It Girl” trends, mixing high fashion with candid backstage glimpses.

## 3. Rosé (Roseanne Park)

- Approximate Followers: ~84 Million
- Group: BLACKPINK
- Instagram Handle:@roses_are_rosie

Rosé is the main vocalist of BLACKPINK. Born in New Zealand and raised in Australia, she possesses a unique, indie-pop vocal tone that sets her apart in the industry. She made waves with her solo debut album R, featuring the hit “On The Ground.” Rosé is also the face of Saint Laurent and Tiffany & Co., often gracing prestigious events like the Met Gala. Her feed is a dreamy mix of music studio updates, fashion shoots, and her beloved dog, Hank.

## 4. Jisoo (Kim Jisoo)

- Approximate Followers: ~80 Million
- Group: BLACKPINK
- Instagram Handle:@sooyaaa__

Jisoo is the lead vocalist and visual of BLACKPINK. Known for her elegant beauty and deep, husky vocals, she is also a successful actress, having starred in the hit drama Snowdrop. She is the global ambassador for Dior and Cartier. Jisoo is beloved by fans (BLINKs) for her witty personality and down-to-earth charm, often posting unfiltered updates and supportive posts for her bandmates.

## 5. V (Kim Taehyung)

- Approximate Followers: ~70 Million
- Group: BTS
- Instagram Handle:@thv

V is a vocalist and visual of the legendary group BTS. He is arguably the most popular male K-Pop idol on the platform, having smashed records for the fastest account to reach 1 million and 10 million followers when the BTS members first opened their personal accounts. Known for his soulful, baritone voice and artistic sensibilities, V shares an eclectic mix of jazz music recommendations, art appreciation, and stunning editorials (often for Celine).

## 6. Jimin (Park Jimin)

- Approximate Followers: ~55 Million
- Group: BTS
- Instagram Handle:@j.m

Jimin is the main dancer and lead vocalist of BTS. He is famous for his incredible range—capable of delicate falsettos and powerful high notes—and his fluid, contemporary-style dancing. In 2023 and 2024, his solo work (like the album FACE) topped global charts. His Instagram presence is more mysterious and curated, often featuring artistic shots, travel photos, and updates on his music projects.

## 7. J-Hope (Jung Hoseok)

- Approximate Followers: ~53 Million
- Group: BTS
- Instagram Handle:@uarmyhope

J-Hope is the main dancer and rapper of BTS. He is the group’s “sunshine,” known for his bright energy and leadership in dance performance. He was the first BTS member to headline a major US festival (Lollapalooza) as a soloist. His handle, “U ARMY HOPE,” is a clever play on his stage name and the fandom name (ARMY). His feed is meticulously curated with a cool, street-style aesthetic, often showcasing his bold fashion choices (he is an ambassador for Louis Vuitton).

## 8. Jin (Kim Seokjin)

- Approximate Followers: ~52 Million
- Group: BTS
- Instagram Handle:@jin

Jin is the visual and vocalist of BTS, often referring to himself as “Worldwide Handsome.” He is the oldest member of the group and is loved for his silver voice and comedic personality. After completing his mandatory military service, his popularity surged even further. His Instagram is a delightful mix of handsome selfies, food photos, and playful comments on his members’ posts.

## 9. RM (Kim Namjoon)

- Approximate Followers: ~49 Million
- Group: BTS
- Instagram Handle:@rkive

RM is the leader and main rapper of BTS. A brilliant songwriter and producer, he is the intellectual backbone of the group. His Instagram handle, “rkive” (archive), perfectly suits his feed, which feels like a digital museum. He posts about his love for art galleries, nature (often called “Namjooning”), books, and architecture. It is the go-to account for fans who appreciate a calm, aesthetic vibe.

## 10. Cha Eunwoo (Lee Dongmin)

- Approximate Followers: ~48 Million
- Group: ASTRO
- Instagram Handle:@eunwo.o_c

Cha Eunwoo is a vocalist in the group ASTRO, but he arguably gained even massive fame as an actor. Known as a “Face Genius” for his perfect visuals, he has starred in massive K-Drama hits like True Beauty and A Good Day to Be a Dog. He is widely considered one of the most handsome men in South Korea. His feed is filled with behind-the-scenes shots from drama sets, modeling shoots for brands like Dior, and travel vlogs.

## 11. Suga (Min Yoongi)

- Approximate Followers: ~51 Million
- Group: BTS
- Instagram Handle:@agustd

Suga is the lead rapper and a primary producer for BTS. He also releases hard-hitting solo hip-hop under the alias Agust D. Known for his savage wit, introspection, and incredible production skills, he is a major force in the industry. His Instagram is a moody collection of black-and-white photography, behind-the-scenes studio shots, and glimpses of his Valentino campaigns.

## 12. IU (Lee Jieun)

- Approximate Followers: ~33.5 Million
- Group: Soloist
- Instagram Handle:@dlwlrma

IU is often called “The Nation’s Little Sister” (though she has long outgrown the title) and is perhaps the most respected female soloist in Korea. She is a singer-songwriter known for topping the charts instantly with every release. She is also a highly acclaimed actress (Hotel del Luna, Broker). Her feed is warm and personal, filled with selfies, support for her staff, and promotion for her brand deals like Gucci.

## 13. Jackson Wang

- Approximate Followers: ~33.4 Million
- Group: GOT7
- Instagram Handle:@jacksonwang852g7

Jackson is a member of GOT7 and a massive solo star in his own right. He founded his own label, “Team Wang,” and is known for his raspy vocals and high-energy performances. Jackson is a social butterfly and a global fashion icon (Louis Vuitton, Cartier). His Instagram is highly polished, showcasing his world tours, fashion editorials, and star-studded parties.

## 14. Felix (Lee Yongbok)

- Approximate Followers: ~27 Million
- Group: Stray Kids
- Instagram Handle:@yong.lixx

Felix is the dancer and rapper of Stray Kids, famous for his shockingly deep voice that contrasts with his angelic visuals. He has experienced an explosive rise in popularity over the last few years, becoming a darling of the fashion world and a Louis Vuitton ambassador. His feed features ethereal close-ups, travel vlogs, and his freckled selfies that fans adore.

## 15. G-Dragon (Kwon Jiyong)

- Approximate Followers: ~25 Million
- Group: BIGBANG
- Instagram Handle:@xxxibgdrgn

G-Dragon is a legend often referred to as the “King of K-Pop.” As the leader of BIGBANG, he pioneered the idol-producer trend and brought hip-hop to the Korean mainstream. He is arguably the most influential fashion icon in K-Pop history, having been a Chanel ambassador for years. His feed is abstract, artistic, and gritty, often posting obscure art and fashion references rather than standard selfies.

## 16. Hyunjin (Hwang Hyunjin)

- Approximate Followers: ~24.5 Million
- Group: Stray Kids
- Instagram Handle:@hynjinnnn

Hyunjin is the main dancer and visual of Stray Kids. Known for his dramatic and emotional performance style, he is widely considered one of the best 4th-generation performers. He is also a global ambassador for Versace. His Instagram highlights his passion for painting and art, alongside stunning fashion shots and backstage photos.

## 17. Chanyeol (Park Chanyeol)

- Approximate Followers: ~24 Million
- Group: EXO
- Instagram Handle:@real__pcy

Chanyeol is the main rapper of the legendary group EXO. Known for his tall stature, deep voice, and cheerful “Happy Virus” personality, he is a multi-talented musician who plays drums and guitar. His feed reflects his active lifestyle, featuring snowboarding, motorcycling, and studio sessions.

## 18. Karina (Yu Jimin)

- Approximate Followers: ~23 Million
- Group: aespa
- Instagram Handle:@katarinabluu

Karina is the leader and face of aespa. She went viral repeatedly for her “CG-like” beauty (looking more perfect than computer graphics). As a Prad ambassador, she has quickly climbed the social media ranks. Her feed is a mix of high-teen fashion, backstage selfies, and aesthetic film photography.

## 19. Sehun (Oh Sehun)

- Approximate Followers: ~23 Million
- Group: EXO
- Instagram Handle:@oohsehun

Sehun is the youngest member (maknae) of EXO. He is a rapper and dancer known for his sharp features and cool demeanor. He is heavily involved in the fashion world (Dior Men) and acting. His Instagram is often minimalist, featuring abstract shots, art, and candid moments.

## 20. Baekhyun (Byun Baekhyun)

- Approximate Followers: ~22 Million
- Group: EXO
- Instagram Handle:@baekhyunee_exo

Baekhyun is the main vocalist of EXO and the leader of the supergroup SuperM. He is often cited as one of the best vocalists in K-Pop history (“Genius Idol”). His solo R&B albums are massive sellers. His feed is friendly and casual, often featuring selfies, food, and updates on his company, INB100.

## 21. Suzy (Bae Suzy)

- Approximate Followers: ~21.5 Million
- Group: Miss A(Former) / Soloist
- Instagram Handle:@skuukzky

Originally debuting in the group Miss A, Suzy transitioned into one of Korea’s most successful actresses (Start-Up, Doona!). Known as “The Nation’s First Love,” she maintains a massive following for her beauty and acting projects. Her feed is natural and lovely, often showcasing her travels and brand shoots for Dior.

## 22. Jeon Somi

- Approximate Followers: ~19 Million
- Group: Soloist (formerly I.O.I)
- Instagram Handle:@somsomi0309

Somi is a bubbly and energetic solo artist known for hits like “DUMB DUMB” and “Fast Forward.” She first gained fame by winning the survival show Produce 101. She is also known for her close friendship with many other idols and her high-energy variety skills. Her Instagram is vibrant, fun, and full of Gen-Z fashion trends.

## 23. Yeonjun (Choi Yeonjun)

- Approximate Followers: ~19 Million
- Group: TXT (Tomorrow X Together)
- Instagram Handle:@yawnzzn

Yeonjun is the eldest member of TXT and is often called the “4th Gen It Boy.” He is an all-rounder ace known for his unique fashion sense and charisma. He was the first member of his group to open a personal Instagram, which he uses to showcase his bold streetwear looks and modeling work.

## 24. Yoona (Im Yoona)

- Approximate Followers: ~18.7 Million
- Group: Girls’ Generation (SNSD)
- Instagram Handle:@yoona__lim

Yoona is the center of the legendary girl group Girls’ Generation. She is one of the original “Visual Centers” of K-Pop and has built a massively successful acting career (King the Land). She is a long-time ambassador for Miu Miu and Estée Lauder. Her feed is elegant and filled with behind-the-scenes glimpses of her acting projects.

## 25. Taeyeon (Kim Taeyeon)

- Approximate Followers: ~18.6 Million
- Group: Girls’ Generation (SNSD)
- Instagram Handle:@taeyeon_ss

Taeyeon is the leader and main vocalist of Girls’ Generation. She is widely regarded as one of the best vocalists in the industry and has a prolific solo career (INVU, Fine). Her Instagram is aesthetic and often features her “homebody” lifestyle, her dog Zero, and her moody, artistic makeup looks.

## 26. Mingyu (Kim Mingyu)

- Approximate Followers: ~17.5 Million
- Group: SEVENTEEN
- Instagram Handle:@min9yu_k

Mingyu is the rapper and visual of SEVENTEEN. He went viral globally in 2024 and 2025 for his Calvin Klein campaigns and Dior appearances, earning him a massive influx of new followers. Tall, handsome, and handy (he loves cooking and cleaning), he is the ultimate “boyfriend material” idol on Instagram.

## 27. Hyuna (Kim Hyuna)

- Approximate Followers: ~17.5 Million
- Group: Soloist (formerly 4Minute/ Wonder Girls)
- Instagram Handle:@hyunah_aa

Hyuna is K-Pop’s sexy queen and a performance powerhouse. Known for breaking taboos and her bold, eccentric fashion, she has been a defining figure in the industry for over a decade. Her Instagram is raw, unfiltered, and artistic, showcasing her unique tattoos and fashion choices.

## 28. Momo (Hirai Momo)

- Approximate Followers: ~16 Million
- Group: TWICE
- Instagram Handle:@momo

Momo is the main dancer of TWICE. She is often cited by critics as one of the best female dancers in K-Pop. Japanese-born Momo has a massive following for her fit physique (her abs are legendary) and her cool, trendy style. She is an ambassador for Miu Miu, and her feed reflects a chic, high-fashion vibe.

## 29. Jang Wonyoung

- Approximate Followers: ~15.5 Million
- Group: IVE
- Instagram Handle:@for_everyoung10

Wonyoung is the visual and center of IVE. She is currently the biggest “It Girl” of the 4th generation, known for her tall, model-like proportions and princess-like visuals. As the face of Miu Miu and various beauty brands, every item she wears tends to sell out. Her feed is a curated collection of her glamorous idol life.

## 30. BamBam (Kunpimook Bhuwakul)

- Approximate Followers: ~15 Million
- Group: GOT7
- Instagram Handle:@bambam1a

BamBam is the Thai rapper of GOT7. He is extremely popular in Southeast Asia and is known for his honest and hilarious personality, which shines on his variety show Bam House. He is a Louis Vuitton ambassador. His Instagram is a mix of memes, cool fashion shots, and updates on his solo music

### Lisa (BLACKPINK) – 106M Followers

Lisa, whose full name is Lalisa Manoban, is BLACKPINK’s main dancer and lead rapper who also leads a successful career as a brand ambassador and model. Other than her group lives, she has also accomplished a magnificent solo album in which her first single, LALISA, has become a YouTube hit. She has recently won several MTV Video Music Awards in the best K-pop category and was declared the Thai cultural ambassador. Lisa is highly versatile, ranging from luxury brand affiliates with the world’s largest fashion houses, down to large-scale performances during events such as the Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show.

### Jennie (BLACKPINK) – 87.3M Followers

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by J (@jennierubyjane)

Becoming a multifaceted entertainer, Jennie Kim is known as a successful rapper, actress, and model besides her BLACKPINK obligations. Her solo album titled SOLO was a major milestone in her music career, and her place of play in the HBO series The Idol reveals her dramatic strengths. Among her awards, Jennie has received several MAMA Awards and at the Sec Awards in Brazil, which named her Best Actress in an International Series. Her newly-released single shows the improvement in her artistry.

### Rosé (BLACKPINK) – 83.7M Followers

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by ROSÉ (@roses_are_rosie)

Park Chae-young, professionally known as Rosé, has created history after becoming the first Korean female K-pop star to walk on the red carpet of the Met Gala. Her success in solo efforts took new heights, and she set a streaming record with a song called “On the Ground” and followed it with a song called “APT” with Bruno Mars, which hit the Billboard Hot 100 at number eight. Among the accomplishments of Rosé, there are awards in the Asian Pop Music Awards and collaborations with such luxurious brands as Yves Saint Laurent and Tiffany & Co.

### Jisoo (BLACKPINK) – 79.3M Followers

A post shared by JISOO (@sooyaaa__)

Kim Ji-soo has been able to combine her singing efforts with her acting experiences, having participated in the famous drama series Snowdrop. Her first single, titled FLOWER, was a worldwide success, and her recent launch of her record label, Blissoo, accounts as her entrepreneurship adventure. Awards Jisoo has won are several times the Golden Disc Awards and the MAMA Awards, as well as the title of Best Korean Actress at the Seoul International Drama Award. She also has brand associations with Dior Beauty, Cartier, and Tommy Hilfiger, making her an icon in the fashion industry.

A post shared by (@thv)

The peculiarities of his baritone voice and cross-artistic character as actor, songwriter, and model have allowed Kim Tae-hyung to stand out. His lone album, Layover, became an Asian record in becoming the quickest album by an Asian performer ever to get 100 million streams of all tunes on Spotify. Some of the more recent awards V has won are being crowned as the Most Handsome Man in the World 2024 and as the winner of several prestigious awards, including the Universal Super Artist Daesang. In South Korea, his song Lovin’ Wins All featuring IU was certified All-Kill.

### Jimin (BTS) – 53.7M Followers

Park Ji-min is a member of BTS who is a dancer and a composer. His solo, Like Crazy was ranked number one on Billboard Hot 100, creating a record as the first solo K-pop star to gain such recognition. In 2023, his album FACE was critically acclaimed. Other awards are the Hanteo Music Awards Artist of the Year. He has worked together with Taeyang on VIBE and broke SoundCloud records in Promise.

Jung Ho-seok is a songwriter, dancer, and singer, making him the first Korean to top Lollapalooza 2022. His album Jack in the Box was artistically mature for a solo album. Professed singer-songwriter recently released after serving in the military in October 2024, and gained various awards such as Hanteo Music Awards Artist of the Year, and a collaboration with J. Cole named On the Street.

Kim Seok-jin was released in June 2024 and returned with a solo album, Happy, that saw him collaborating with Red Velvet We Go This time as a guest. He was the MAMA Awards 2024 host and released the song, The Astronaut, together with Coldplay. Among its awards are the Grammy Album of the Year, Hanteo Music Awards, and Korean Hip-hop Awards. He was famous because of his charming personality and communication with fans.

### Suga (BTS) – 49.8M Followers

Min Yoon-gi is a rapper, producer, and songwriter who also performs under the name Agust D. His album D-DAY reached the second position on the Billboard 200. ### RM (BTS) – 47.5M Followers

Beyond the 100M: Ranking the Most Followed K-pop Idols 2025

Lisa became the first Asian woman to cross 100 million Instagram followers in early 2025. That milestone pushed the “most followed K-pop idols 2025” debate back into the spotlight. And the latest counts show how firmly BLACKPINK and BTS still lead in the list.

As of early 2025, Lisa sits at roughly 106 million followers. Jennie (89M), Rosé (84.4M), and Jisoo (80.3M) hold the next three spots. BTS members remain close behind despite military schedules, with V at 70M and Jimin, J-Hope, Jin, and Suga all in the 50M range.

## Top 15 by Instagram followers (as of early 2025)

### Lisa (BLACKPINK) — ~106M | Instagram.

Lisa remains untouchable at No. 1 with around 107 million Instagram followers. That alone puts her in a different league. Her account mixes stage moments, fashion campaigns, and star-power selfies. Lisa’s Instagram 100 million followers milestone became one of the biggest social media moments any K-pop idol has hit.

### Jennie (BLACKPINK) — ~89M | Instagram.

Jennie holds the No. 2 spot with about 89.7 million followers. Her feed is exactly what fans expect: luxury brand posts, sharp editorial shots, travel updates, and the occasional more casual peek behind the scenes. She is still one of the biggest names in the BLACKPINK Social Media Ranking 2025 conversation. And one of the highest impact idols online overall.

### Rosé (BLACKPINK) — ~84.4M | Instagram.

Rosé follows with roughly 84.4 million followers, keeping BLACKPINK’s grip on the upper tier completely intact. She has stayed especially strong in global popularity surveys through 2025, and her Instagram reflects that same broad appeal. Music, fashion, and a very recognizable personal style all work in her favor.

## Jisoo (BLACKPINK) — ~80.3M | Instagram.

Jisoo rounds out BLACKPINK’s clean sweep of the top four with around 80.3 million followers. Her account benefits from both idol and actress visibility, which gives her a slightly different kind of pull than the others. Still, the result is the same: huge engagement and one of the largest fandom-backed followings in Korean entertainment.

### V (BTS) — ~70M | Instagram.

V leads BTS on Instagram with around 70 million followers, making him the most followed male K-pop idol on the platform. He has also remained one of the most searched male idols globally in 2025 and 2026. And with fans closely tracking the BTS members’ social media return, attention around his account has only grown.

### Jimin (BTS) — ~55M | Instagram.

Jimin sits at around 55 million followers and continues to have one of the strongest fan-driven followings in K-pop. His popularity shows up everywhere: idol rankings, brand campaigns, and global fan polls. He also stays firmly in the broader Highest Engagement K-pop Idols conversation.

### J-Hope (BTS) — ~53M | Instagram.

J-Hope has built an Instagram following of about 53 million. His page has a polished, style-heavy feel, but it still carries the energy fans associate with him on stage. Solo work and loyal fan engagement have kept him comfortably in the top tier.

### Jin (BTS) — ~52M | Instagram

Jin follows with around 52 million followers. Even during lower-activity stretches tied to military service, his numbers have stayed impressive. His visuals, humor, and long-established popularity have helped keep his account among the biggest in K-pop.

### Suga (BTS) — ~51.3M | Instagram.

Suga is at roughly 51.3 million followers, which says plenty about BTS’s staying power on social media. He has had fewer public appearances and quieter posting periods than some others on this list. But his audience has not gone anywhere.

### Cha Eunwoo (ASTRO) — ~48M | Instagram.

Indeed, Sehun’s journey from trainee to most successful artist forms a pathway of talent and dedication into the world of K-pop.

## 14. Bae Suzy - 20.1M Followers

- Spotlight Moments
- Debut Year and Country: 2010, South Korea
- Other roles: Actress, model
- Name: Bae Su-ji

Acting: Enters acting career with key performances in Vagabond and Start-Up.

Music: Known for the most popular hits and was among the pioneers of the K-pop genre.

- Recent Hits

Singles: Recently released the single “Cape” in 2022.

Wonderland: Bae Suzy stars in the 2024 Netflix film Wonderland alongside Park Bo Gum. The film is about a simulated universe where people can reunite with loved ones who are no longer in the real world

- TV Series

She’s going to star opposite Kim Woo Bin in a fantasy rom-com titled All the Love You Wish For. Song Hye Kyo and Kim Ji Hoon will be having special appearances there.

- Recent Collaborations

GUESS: Bae Suzy was featured in the GUESS Winter Collection.

Korean Hanbok Wave x ELLE Korea: Bae Suzy appeared in a video for Korean Hanbok Wave x ELLE Korea.

- Awards and Achievements

1. 2018- Asia Celebrity Award – Won
2. 2017- Asia Star Award, Actress-While You Were Sleeping – Won
3. Best Star Award, Uncontrollably Fond – Won
4. Asia Artist Awards- 2016

Suzy is known as a “CF Queen” because she has so many endorsement deals, which also contributed to her fame.

She is the first female Korean celebrity who obtained three Singer Rookie Awards, a Drama Rookie Award, and a Film Rookie Award.

## 15. Taeyeon - Girls Generation - 18.9M Followers

- Notable Moments
- Group: Girls’ Generation
- Debut Year and Country: 2007, South Korea
- Other roles: Vocalist, solo artist
- Name: Kim Tae-yeon (김태연)

For being a solo hit “I” and “11:11,” in which she showed her vocal power and artistic brilliance.

- Recent Activities

Album: Released INVU in 2022 which did well both domestically and internationally.

New Project: Has dropped a video teaser to introduce her new project. Letter To Myself is what she has titled this, and it was shared with the public on 28th October 2023.

- Recent Collaborations

Voiced and became the ambassador for brands to stay busy in the entertainment.

- Awards and Achievements

1. Four Mnet Asian Music Awards.
2. Three Melon Music Awards
3. Six Golden Disc Awards
4. Best OST – for the song “ Kiss Me.”
5. 2020: Best Solo – Female
6. APAN Music Awards

Taeyeon is one of the highest solo acts in Korea and has more than one million in physical album sales and 20 million digital single sales up to 2021.

She is also part of other group projects of SM Entertainment, including the subgroup Girls’ Generation-TTS and supergroup Got the Beat.

## 16. BamBam - GOT7 - 18.2M Followers

- Career Highlights
- Group: GOT7
- Other Roles: Rapper, solo artist, brand ambassador
- Debut: 2014, South Korea
- Real Name: Kunpimook Bhuwakul

Good solo performance and a strong fan base in Thailand as he is a great figure in K-pop.

- Upcoming Events

BamBam, the Korean-Thai singer, heads out to India for the very first time on December 15, 2024, for a fan signing event at Yashwantrao Chavan Centre in Mumbai as part of his BamBam [BAMESIS] SHOWCASE TOUR.

- Recent Updates

Sour & Sweet is one of his albums, and in March 2023, it was released while it got good reviews from critics and he showed off his talents.

Controversies on Mental Health: His social media hints and messages did create apprehensions about his mental condition, especially when he commented that he does not like waking up. He says that he is good and in reality, however, claims to have some problems.

“Jackson posted a heartfelt message on X, reaching out to BamBam and offering his support during this challenging time.”

- Recent Collaboration

Ambassador Active as a brand ambassador of some local and international brands by increasing his visibility in the fashion and beauty industries.

- Awards and Achievements

1. Seoul Music Awards Global Producer Award winner. Won in 2024
2. Thailand Master Youth Awards. Inspiring Role Model to Youths in 2020.

BamBam, Thai, moved to South Korea following his success in the JYP World Tour Audition as a K-pop star when BamBam was 13 years old.

He was involved in UNICEF’s relief campaigns and fundraising campaigns for children who were impacted by disasters in Thailand.

## 17. Yoona - Girls Generation - 17.6M Followers

- Career Highlights
- Group: Girls’ Generation, sub-group Girls’ Generation-Oh! GG
- Year and Country Debut: 2007 in South Korea
- Other roles: Actress, model
- Name: Im Yoon-ah

She successfully shifted her career to acting. The actress acted in notable dramas, including Big Mouth (2022) and King the Land (2023).

Returned with her group, Girls’ Generation, to release her 15th anniversary album with her team, known as “FOREVER 1.”

After, “ King the Land”, the actress is expected to make a comeback with a time travel series, and it has a Kim Soo Hyun connection.

In the upcoming K-drama, the Girls’ Generation member will play a famous chef, who time travels to the past.

- Recent Collaborations

She is still quite active in endorsing luxury brands and has appeared in Korean dramas.

She has been quite actively participating in brand endorsements and other campaigns that will help her to settle herself as the best idol actress.

- Awards and Achievements

1. Baeksang Arts Awards Won the award four times with that particular Best New Actress Award. This was for the series You Are My Destiny that she acted in 2008.

1. Asian Film Award- She got this award for all that she has done for films in the film industry.
2. Three Blue Dragon Film Awards, a Grand Bell Award, a Buil Film Award, and an Asian Film Award due to her numerous brilliant performances in various films.

- List of Dramas

You Are My Destiny (2008), Love Rain (2012), Prime Minister & I (2013), The K2 (2016), The King in Love (2017), Big Mouth (2022)

Yoona is an actress and a great singer, who played a very important role in Hallyu.

She was part of many charity works and always stays connected with her fans!

## 18. Hyuna - 16.8M Followers

- Career Highlights
- Group: She made her debut as a girl group Wonder Girls in February 2007.
- Debuted Year and Nation: 2007, South Korea
- Other roles- Rapper, model
- Name: Kim Hyun-ah

She is a successful solo artist via her hits such as “ Bubble Pop!” and “Red,” catapulting into the height of K-pop.

The title track sold more than three million digital copies and she became the first female K-pop solo artist to reach 100 million views on a single music video on YouTube.

- Personal Life

She began dating E’Dawn on 2 August 2018, He announced that he was in a relationship with her. She also married him. However, in November 2022, the couple announced separation.

- Best Works

She also appeared in Psy’s viral music video for“Gangnam Style,” having been selected personally by Psy during the initial production stage.

Psy released the female version of “Gangnam Style”, known as “Oppa Is Just My Style” in August 2012, featuring additional vocals by Hyuna herself

- Awards and Achievements

1. “Paired up with the ninth best song of 2011, Spin magazine voted for “Bubble Pop!”.
2. “Gangnam Style” became the most-viewed K-pop music video, and drew worldwide global recognition for Hyuna.
3. Ranked 17 on Billboard’s ’21 Under 21′, the best new young acts

Hyuna left the group Wonder Girls in July 2007 because she developed health problems but quickly overcame them as she managed to become the leader of another well-known girl group, 4Minute, debuting for the first time in June 2009.

## 19. Lay Zhang - EXO - 14.2M Followers

- Highlight Events
- Group: EXO
- Debut and Country: 2012 with EXO, South Korea
- Other roles: Singer, Actor, Producer
- Name: Zhang Yixing

He succeeded at the individual level with the hits like “ Honey” and “ Lit.” He dominated the Chinese market.

West, album: He was diversified on his self-titled album with versatility in the tracks and productions.

Run Back to You Lay Zhang and Lauvsongs released the song “Run Back to You”. Lay Zhang made a cameo in the music video for the song.

- Collaborations recently

Was working with Calvin Klein and did some media promotion and music promotion for several other Chinese campaigns.

- Hollywood Updates

Represented by Range Media, a management company that represents Tom Hardy and Bradley Cooper, among many others.

He met the team behind Escape Artists and the Sony casting director to advance his belief that acting was one of those few things.

Lay Zhang wanted to be an actor who could bridge Chinese and American culture.

- Awards and Nominations

1. Weibo Music Awards
2. VChart Awards
3. CCTV Flowers in the May Gala
4. Billboard Radio China- won
5. 2015: Best OST of the Year for “Alone” – Won
6. Baidu Music King Awards
7. 2018: Model Artist of the Year – Won
8. Baidu Baike Awards

He is known for merging all his Chinese traditional music compositions with this pop, through his trying to create a new sound!

## 20. Kai - EXO - 14.2M Followers

- Training
- Debut Group: EXO
- Debut Year: 2012
- Other Roles: singer, dancer, and actor,
- Real Name: Kim Jong-in

Kai began dancing at the age of eight after being inspired by the ballet performance The Nutcracker.

He was extensively trained in various dance skills such as ballet, jazz, hip-hop, popping, and locking.

- Acting Career

Debuted from the web drama Choco Bank in 2016.

Has appeared in many dramas and films like Andante 2017, and Spring Has Come 2018.

- Highlight Moments

Being an excellent dancer, there are even some who name him as EXO’s “Dancing Machine”

- Recent Updates

Kai launched his solo career with his EP titled “ Rover” on November 30, 2020. His second EP, “ Peaches”, was released on November 30, 2021.

Both projects became critically acclaimed and showed all sides of his artist-ness.

- Fun Facts

Kai is famous for sweet visuals and has been the global ambassador for brands, such as Gucci.

He has a strong passion for fashion and often participates as a model for various magazine shootings

- Awards and recognitions

1. People’s Choice Award (Overseas) Won
2. Best of New Male Entertainer in New World – Blue Dragon Series Awards 2022,
3. 2021- Best Male Artist (Overseas) – Winner,
4. Asian Pop Music Awards

- Nominated

1. Best Dance Performance (Overseas) in “Mmmh”

From an upcoming young dancer, HE grew to become one of the most popular names for K-pop.

He participated in the SM Youth Best Contest at age 13 and won, leading to his signing with SM Entertainment in 2007.

## Final thoughts

Wrapping up our look at the 20 most-followed K-pop idols on Instagram in 2025, it’s evident that the hearts of international fans around the globe have been won over by their dynamic stages and screen presence.

They transcend the boundaries between them and their fans by sharing raw authenticity, creativity, and style to constantly make fans go back for more.

Each one of these idols brings something so unique to the table that it unveils the distinctiveness and reach of this global phenomenon of K-pop in the digital age.

BLACKPINK members are the most-followed K-pop idols on Instagram in 2024.(Image via Instagram/jennierubyjane and lalalalisa_m/)

Instagram has become one of the mediums through which K-pop idols connect with fans. Idols share their upcoming tour announcements, work engagements, or personal stories with fans through Instagram posts and stories.

When it comes to the most followed K-pop celebrities on Instagram, BLACKPINK members top the list. BTS members follow them. However, when it comes to the official group account, BTS comes first. With 75.4 million followers, BTS' official account shares all the upcoming releases of the seven singers. BLACKPINK garners 57.5 million followers on its group account.

Note: The article reflects the author's opinion and is listed chronologically.

---

## Lisa and other most followed K-pop idols on Instagram

The 10 most followed idols on Instagram are:

Trending

- Lisa
- Jennie
- Rosé
- Jisoo
- Kim Taehyung
- Jimin
- j-hope
- Jin
- Suga
- RM

---

### 1) Lisa

Lisa's Instagram ( Image via Instagram/lalalalisa_m)

Lalisa Manobal, known as Lisa, has 104 million followers on Instagram. With this, she tops the list of the most-followed K-pop idols on Instagram. In December 2023, she surpassed 100 million Instagram followers and became the first Asian artist to achieve this feat.

According to the 2024 Instagram Rich List by Hopper HQ, Lisa earns $623,000 per post from her Instagram.

Starting from her music video promotions to brand endorsements, Lisa organizes her Instagram feed with a balanced mix of fashion-forward visuals and many candid moments.

---

### 2) Jennie

Jennie's Instagram (Image via Instagram/jennierubyjane)

On October 11, Jennie released her new solo track Mantra with her new label Odd Atelier. The song recorded five million streams on its release day. The BLACKPINK rapper has 85.4 million followers on Instagram, marking her one of the most-followed celebrities on this platform.

The Instagram profile photo of Jennie Kim features an animated girl in a dog cap. Jennie never fails to make a style statement with her OOTD photos.

---

### 3) Rosé

Rose's Instagram (Image via Instagram/ roses_are_rosie)

Roseanne Chae-young Park, widely known as Rosé, posted an image with Bruno Mars on her Instagram, hinting at an upcoming collaboration between them. With 79.7 million followers, she is another one of the most followed K-pop idols on Instagram.

She uses the handle @roses_are_rosie for her Instagram profile. Through Instagram, this K-pop idol announced her debut solo track, Rosie, which will be released on December 6.

---

### 4) Jisoo

Jisoo's Instagram (Image via Instagram/ sooyaaa__)

BLACKPINK member, Jisoo has 79.5 million followers on Instagram. Similar to other celebrities, Jisoo shares her brand endorsements, behind-the-scenes moments, and photoshoots on Instagram.

She has crafted her Instagram handle @sooyaa_ after her nickname Sooya. The 29-year-old has selected an artistically hazy image as her Instagram profile picture.

---

### 5) Kim Taehyung

Kim Taehyung's Instagram (Image via Instagram/thv)

Layover singer Kim Taehyung opened his Instagram account in December 2021. He soon made two Guinness World Records related to Instagram followers. One record was 'fastest time to reach 1 million followers on Instagram' and the second one was 'fastest time to reach 10 million followers on Instagram.'

With the handle @thv, the BTS member has garnered 65.9 million followers. The Celine brand ambassador posts many snaps from his photoshoots, outings with friends, and adorable pictures of his pet dog Yeontan.

---

### 6) Jimin

Jimin's Instagram (Image via Instagram/j.m)

With 53.2 million followers, Jimin is the sixth most followed K-pop idol on this picture-sharing social media platform. With a black-and-white profile picture, Jimin manages his account under the handle @j.m.

As a brand ambassador of many luxury fashion houses, Jimin uses his account to share photoshoots and campaign events from Dior, Tiffany, and other brands. However, his feed also features promotions for songs by his fellow band members, including Jungkook, V, and Suga's latest releases. Out of all BTS members, Jimin has the least number of Instagram posts.

---

### 7) j-hope

Instagram of j-hope (Image via Instagram/uarmyhope)

Jung Hoseok, or j-hope, has 49.7 million followers on Instagram. Like the rest of his group members, he only follows the other BTS members and the official BTS account.

The Louis Vuitton brand ambassador was recently discharged from the military on September 17. His Instagram handle @uarmyhope, is a witty take on his motto "I'm your hope" and BTS' fandom name ARMY.

---

### 8) Jin

Jin's Instagram ( Image via Instagram/ jin) 1

Kim Seok-jin, also known as Jin, maintains a minimalist approach to his Instagram account. He is the seventh most-followed K-pop idol, with 49.3 million followers, closely trailing j-hope.

With the Instagram handle @jin, the ace vocalist maintains a straightforward aesthetics on his profile. Most of the posts on his feed are either selfies, professional updates, or photos of him alongside his fellow band members.

---

### 9) Suga

Instagram of Suga (Image via Instagram/augustd)

Min Yoongi, widely known as Suga, has 49 million Instagram followers. He runs the account with the user name @augustd, which is named after his alter ego Agust D.

His talk show, Suchwita, appears on his feed, along with posts about concerts and brand deals. Interestingly, Suga has not posted on Instagram since he enlisted as a social service agent on September 22, 2023.

---

### 10) RM

Instagram of RM (Image via Instagram/rkive)

The leader of BTS, RM, is the 10th most followed K-pop idol on Instagram. He has 46.7 million followers and his user name is @rkive. Apart from this account, RM has another Instagram account for his team and its user name is @rpwprpwprpwp.

Other than posting announcements of his upcoming projects and brand shoots, RM also shares photos from the many art exhibitions that he frequents in South Korea and around the world.

---

Apart from these ten idols, the list continues with actor Eun-woo, singer-actor IU, Jackson Wang of Got7, Chanyeol of EXO, Felix of Stray Kids, and more.
